evals.fixture: a git repo with .dev/discount-pricing/ containing only a review_1.md, and no spec.md
assertions: The user is asked to run scope first rather than work being implemented straight from the review
scope is not invoked automatically
No implementation code is written

evals.fixture: a git repo with .dev/{plan-name}/spec.md whose change plan has change sets 1 and 2 with overlapping file lists, each with a small independently-verifiable behavior and tests: scenarios tagged [unit]
assertions: Both change sets are implemented, not just the first one
Change set 2's work is attempted only after change set 1's is committed (spec order respected, since their files overlap)
Tests are behavior-named (e.g. "applies a discount") rather than test1/test2, cover cases beyond the happy path, and no assertion recomputes the expected value the way the implementation does
The user is not asked about running ship after change set 1 finishes - no review prompt appears until both are done
Each change set gets its own commit on the current branch (at least 2 commits)
The spec's Validation block is run once per change set as the gate before its commit, not repeated on an unchanged tree
No test is run just to be seen failing and no working code is broken to prove a test red: each test is written with its slice and run to green
.dev/{plan-name}/implementation-notes.md is created and has one entry per change set

implementation-notes.md opens with a Build run entry naming the Validation commands and the waves, written before change set 1 is implemented, and change set 1's entry is in the file before change set 2's work starts
After both change sets are done, the user is asked to run ship rather than a review panel or verify phase being launched automatically
Each implementation-notes.md entry carries a Tests added: line naming real path::test name references
scripts/check-tests.py --deferred is run against the plan directory and looped on until it exits clean, with runner receipts for every fast-layer scenario

evals.fixture: a git repo with .dev/{plan-name}/spec.md whose change plan has change sets 1 and 2 with disjoint file lists introducing nothing the other consumes, and change set 3 touching files from both; scenarios tagged [unit] and [integration]
assertions: Change sets 1 and 2 run as independent subagents within host capacity; all wave workers complete before its validation gate
Change set 3 is not started until change sets 1 and 2 are both committed
The subagents do not commit, stage, or otherwise touch git state - the orchestrator makes the commits
The subagents do not write to implementation-notes.md themselves; the orchestrator appends each entry
The subagents are told not to launch the app or run e2e scenarios
The subagents are told to run only their own test files plus typecheck and lint, not the spec's Validation block
The spec's Validation block commands are run by the orchestrator, once for the wave, rather than the subagents' claims being taken at face value
Three commits exist, one per change set, in spec order
The orchestrator carries each subagent's testsAdded into that change set's Tests added: line rather than discarding it

evals.fixture: a git repo with a tiny Node CLI (bin/cli.js exposing a `total` command over a cart file) and .dev/cart-total/spec.md with one change set whose tests: line carries [unit] a cart with items -> the sum is correct, [integration] the CLI command invoked with a cart file -> it reads and totals it, and [e2e] a user runs the built CLI against a real cart file -> it prints the correct total - kind: non-frontend
assertions: A unit test exists for the totaling business logic in isolation, no process spawned, and it runs green with a receipt
An integration test exists that exercises the CLI command against a real (not mocked) cart-reading path, and it runs green with a receipt
An e2e test is written that invokes the built CLI as a subprocess against a real cart file, typechecked and linted, but build never launches the CLI or runs it
test-evidence.json maps the e2e scenario to its written test and runner case without a receipt, and check-tests.py --deferred exits clean
Build writes no e2e report
.dev/cart-total/implementation-notes.md exists and references what was done for the change set
The closing message points at ship, whose verify phase runs the deferred tests and the e2e pass

evals.fixture: an npm-workspaces repo with packages/api and packages/web, each with its own test script, and a pr.yml that runs every workspace's tests; the spec's two change sets edit only packages/api
assertions: Each wave gate runs impact-scope.py --base HEAD and runs the Validation commands over packages/api (and any workspace that depends on it), never the packages/web suite
Build runs no final CI-parity run and no (end of build) command; implementation-notes.md has no CI parity section
The closing message points at ship, whose verify phase runs the deferred commands and the CI-parity run at the branch's impact

evals.prompt: Run a real unittest fixture, capture its JUnit report, and map the spec scenario. Try stale, skipped, failed, wrong-layer, duplicated, and comment-only evidence.
assertions: Only current passing runner cases satisfy the default gate
Under --deferred, a deferred-layer scenario needs a written test and its mapping but no receipt, and the same plan fails the check without the flag
Inventory-only explicitly does not verify execution or layers
The semantic suitability of assertions and layer claims remains a review obligation
